subject.title: perf: use a focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics

question: Should diagnostic runs use a new focused OpenClaw prepack contract, and exactly which release contents may it omit without weakening Kova's release-shaped validation?
rationale: The omission boundary and owning repository are product and harness-contract choices that cannot be inferred safely from the title or adjacent optimizations.

options.title: Specify focused profile
options.body: Define the safe contents and performance target, then implement the contract in its owning packaging surface and consume it from Kova.

options.title: Preserve full package
options.body: Keep the generic release package and reduce diagnostic latency through package caching or reuse without changing artifact contents.

options.title: Decline optimization
options.body: Close the direction explicitly if diagnostic package time is not material enough to justify another packaging contract.

recommendation.title: Specify focused profile
recommendation.body: Define the safe contents and performance target, then implement the contract in its owning packaging surface and consume it from Kova.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the issue and has the strongest recent history in Kova performance and reporting optimization.
